description: Header file defining the OemLock class in the cuttlefish::oemlock namespace, providing an interface for OEM lock management through Result-wrapped methods.

classes.name: OemLock
classes.description: Provides an interface to manage OEM lock status using a storage backend.

methods.name: OemLock
methods.description: Constructor accepting a reference to a storage object.

methods.name: IsOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by the carrier.

methods.name: IsOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by the device.

methods.name: IsOemUnlockAllowed
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is overall allowed.

methods.name: IsOemLocked
methods.description: Checks if OEM is currently locked.

methods.name: SetOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by the carrier.

methods.name: SetOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by the device.
